data.name: Haleakala Self-Guided Downhill Bike Tour
data.headline: OUR SIGNATURE EXPERIENCE & BEST-SELLING BIKE TOUR! Experience Maui's Famous Mountain-to-Sea Ride!
data.description: Experience Maui’s most iconic ride from the mountain to the sea with Maui Sunriders! After a narrated van tour up to 6,500 feet on Haleakala, enjoy a self-guided downhill bike ride through fragrant eucalyptus groves, charming upcountry towns, and along scenic coastal roads. Ride at your own pace with plenty of opportunities for photos, stops, and exploration. Roadside assistance is available throughout, ensuring a safe and flexible adventure. This scenic journey is a perfect way to experience Maui’s natural beauty while supporting local businesses along the route.
data.highlights:
Ride one of the world’s most iconic downhill cycling routes, starting high on the slopes of Haleakala and coasting nearly all downhill to the sea. It’s the perfect Maui adventure for those who want big views without a strenuous climb.

Breathe in the crisp mountain air and enjoy the fragrant eucalyptus groves, along with the scenic flora that brighten the landscape along the route. Every stretch of road offers a new scenic surprise.

Enjoy the freedom to explore charming upcountry Makawao town at your own pace. Stop for coffee, browse local shops, or simply take in the slower rhythm of Maui life as you roll through the countryside.

Take in sweeping ocean vistas and expansive views of Maui’s coastline around nearly every curve. With countless photo opportunities, this ride is as scenic as it is memorable.

Best of all, the experience is completely self-guided — giving you flexibility and independence, while still having Maui Sunriders’ roadside support always nearby.
data.itinerary:
1. **Check-In at Paia Shop (8:45 AM)**
Arrive at Maui Sunriders in Paia for a warm welcome, gear fitting, and comprehensive safety briefing. You’ll receive a full-face helmet, gloves, rain/wind gear, backpack, and a high-performance bike.

2. **Scenic Van Tour to 6,500 Feet**
Enjoy a narrated 45-minute van ride up Haleakala. Your guide will share Maui’s unique history, volcanic landscapes, and cultural insights.

3. **Begin Self-Guided Bike Ride**
Start your ride just outside Haleakala National Park at 6,500 feet. Cruise through upcountry Maui with panoramic ocean and valley views. Stop for photos, explore at your own pace, and enjoy the fresh mountain air.

4. **Van Shuttle Through Kula (Highway Bypass)**
For safety, Maui County law requires all bike tours to bypass a short stretch of Kula Highway. Riders will be transported in the van past this section before continuing their ride.

5. **Continue Riding Through Makawao**
Explore the charming upcountry town of Makawao, known for its cowboy roots and local arts scene. Take time for coffee, shopping, or a casual lunch.

6. **Final Descent to Paia**
Enjoy the last scenic stretch through Maui’s lush North Shore before returning to Paia. Bikes must be returned by 1:30 PM.

**Terms & Conditions**
Phone and online reservations are our principal booking systems. When upon a reservations a customer submits a credit card account number it is mutually understood and agreed that his/her reservation is confirmed, and at check-in time his/her space will be guaranteed.

- No Beginners *(If you haven't been on a bike in over 10 years, we highly suggest you re-consider this bike ride. This isn't a ride to re-familiarize yourself with biking, you should be confident and comfortable riding a bike.*

- No youth under the age of 15 (per Maui County Laws)
- Minors (under 18) must be accompanied by an adult

data.booking_notes:
**Things to Bring/Remember:**

- Wear closed-toe shoes
- Bring Sunglasses
- Bring Sunscreen
- Dress in Light Layers
- Bring a Rain Jacket if you have one, otherwise one is included
- Bring $ for meal stop, possible shopping & singles for fruit stands 
- Bring Camera
- Water (we also sell water in the shop)
* Tip: Any day on Maui has a chance of rain, even on a blue-bird beautiful day and especially during winter. If you do get wet, it's nice to have a change of clothes and flip-flops for after the ride.

**Estimated Itinerary**

 - 8:45am: Check-in at our Paia shop. Gear fitting & safety briefing
 - 9am: If you are not here by 9am you risk not being able to participate as we cannot hold the vans for late parties
 - Once Check-In is Complete: Begin 45 min. narrated drive to the ride staging area at  6,500′

**Ride Experience:**

 - Start 6.5-mile self-guided ride through spectacular upcountry Maui ranchland
 - Van pickup: 15-minute drive through congested highway
 - Unload bikes and ride into Makawao town. An unstructured hour to explore!
 - By 12:45pm: Begin self-guided 7-mile descent back to our shop in Paia…right where you started!
 - 1:30pm All riders back to Paia and bikes off Baldwin Ave

---
**Weather and What to Wear:**
The weather can be unpredictable in the tropics so dress comfortably. We will provide you with a wind/rain jacket and pants, bike gloves, as well as a helmet, backpack, bike lock & a map. If the forecast calls for sun, you can get away with shorts and a shirt. If the weather calls for clouds, wind, or showers you may want leggings/pants and light removable upper layers.


---
Because this tour is 98% downhill with virtually no climbing, we’ve simplified our fleet to single-speed, front-suspension mountain bikes. With thousands of guests riding our bikes each year, single-speed bikes help minimize mechanical issues and ensure a smooth, worry-free ride. We understand that some advanced cyclists may prefer gears. If you have any concerns, please feel free to call our Paia shop (ext. 1) so we can chat about the ride and make sure you have a great experience.

---
**Gratuity is appreciated and is an expression of your satisfaction if you feel your guide provided an exceptional experience. Tips go directly to your guide and recognize the wide-ranging care they provide—from guiding the ride, to maintaining and preparing equipment, to ensuring your safety on the tour. Gratuity is entirely at your discretion; however, 18–20% of the ticket price is a common benchmark.


If you have any questions, feel free to contact us. Mahalo for choosing Maui Sunriders and we look forward to seeing you soon!
